benchmark_observations.threshold_failure: The <=10% calibration FAR threshold causes 80.95% overall and 100% small-object held-out false abstention.
benchmark_observations.duplicate_candidate_problem: Temporal spacing saved frames but reduced calibration routed R@5 from 90.74% to 88.89% at the selected radius/top-K.

decision.recommendation: Improve coarse candidate generation and semantic temporal diversification before another detector or production integration. Preserve the current production path.
